The wreckage of an intercepted 9M723-2F3 modernized ballistic missile from the 9K720 Iskander-M system was found in Kyiv following last night’s attack.
Western monitoring resources and Ukrainian sources indicate that three missiles launched from Kursk Oblast were involved in the attack.
